evidence.quote: Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release

observations.why: Quinton's quoted mandate makes the gate binding on every deploy; the rule is enacted through command, not negotiated. Witnessed through the memo's rendering of his speech, so reported.

evidence.quote: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: The memo sets the gate as a standing rule for all Meridian deploys, a command issued from the decision-maker's position.
Assigns ownership of the gate to a named person, a rank-based allocation of responsibility.
